definitions.explanation: A grassland that stretches as far as the eye can see, such as the Mongolian steppe or the North American prairie.

examples.japanese: {大草原|だいそうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
モンゴル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大草原|だいそうげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I rode a horse across the Mongolian steppe.

examples.japanese: {大草原|だいそうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げた→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧⟦{星空|ほしぞら}→星空：05048_hoshizora⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I'll never forget the starry sky I looked up at in the middle of that great grassland.

notes:
{大|だい} (great) + ⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧ (grassland). Used for grasslands that reach the horizon: the Mongolian steppe, the North American prairie, the African savanna. It carries a sense of openness and freedom, and is common in travel writing and titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大草原|だいそうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a vast grassland spreads out
- モンゴル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大草原|だいそうげん}: the Mongolian steppe
- {大草原|だいそうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: Little House on the Prairie (the Japanese title)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧: grassland, meadow — any size
- ⟦{平原|へいげん}→平原：27685_heigen⟧: plain — flat open land, not necessarily grassy
